selection: All 8 BBCA cash dividend events present in the saved Sectors response for 2022–2025; chosen before fetching their new price windows. Excludes pre-2022 split-basis ambiguity. Two months of 2024 prices were already seen in an earlier audit, so this is not a blind preregistered experiment.
reference_day: last observed trading day strictly before ex-date
price_forecast: At cum-day close, predict post-ex price using empirical median relative paths from six 2022–2024 events. Also compare constant-price and constant Pcum-DPS baselines. Empirical 10th–90th percentile spread is descriptive and uncalibrated.
benchmark: IHSG price index; simple market-adjusted returns, beta implicitly 1; not causal dividend effect.
declaration_analysis: Only use verified Sectors declaration timestamps; if absent, do not relabel ex-date/AGM/news timestamps as declaration.

costs.label: Gross; before transaction fees, taxes and slippage

minimum_data_policy: No fill-forward for missing prices. Mark missing event stages and exclude incomplete offset calculations. Retain unrecovered cases as censored.
use: Initial descriptive research and retrospective forecasting experiment; not validated production signals.
